name: Ascii Side View — 3D rotation from front to side
description: Fixed demo prompt (mug with handle on right): the same front-view ASCII is run many times. The agent outputs the side view after 90° rotation. Step reward = IoU improvement over the previous submission minus penalties for illegal characters and wrong grid dimensions.

binding_vow.description: Fixed mug prompt every episode (seed varies run id only). Up to 5 refinement steps per episode. Observation: { task, description, front_view, output_rules, example, steps_left; after step 1 also previous_iou, feedback }. Action: ASCII grid ONLY (# and .). Step reward = max(0, IoU − prev_IoU) − illegal_char_penalty − size_mismatch_penalty. Episode ends on exact match or step cap. Final score tracks final IoU.

observation_space.description: { task, description, front_view, output_rules, example, steps_left, optional previous_iou/best_iou/previous_submission/feedback }

action_space.description: STRICT: side-view ASCII grid ONLY. Each line must use ONLY # (solid) and . (empty). Do NOT include any explanation, reasoning, labels, or markdown. Grid dimensions must match the expected canvas size.

reward.description: Per-step: IoU gain vs previous submission minus penalties (illegal chars: 0.02 each up to 0.25; wrong row/col count: 0.12). Episode total = sum of step rewards. Terminal final_iou reported in info.
